subject: MONTHLY STORAGE TRANSFER REMINDER
notice_text:
MONTHLY STORAGE TRANSFERS FOR SEPTEMBER 1,
2026
DART provides the ability for storage customers to
enter their own storage transfers online. The transfers must be confirmed
on or before the effective date. If you have a terminated or recalled
contract that needs the balance transferred to the base storage contract holder
or a new contract, these transfers need to be completed on or before the
first of the month.
For terminated storage contracts per the firm storage
rate schedule of the Tennessee Gas Pipeline tariff on First Revised Sheet No.
217, Section 11: “Shippers must withdraw or transfer its Storage Balance on
or before the date of the expiration of its FS Service Agreement. To the
extent that a Shipper fails to dispose of or transfer its entire Storage
Balance, Transporter shall retain and take title to Shipper's remaining Storage
Balance at no cost to Transporter.”
PLEASE NOTE:
When the first of the month falls on a weekend or holiday, any
small volume left on a terminated or recalled storage contract will be moved
for the customers by TGP to the new valid contract if requested by the customer
on the first business day following the weekend or holiday
provided that efforts have been made prior to the first and/or
holiday to transfer allocated balances prior to the weekend and/or holiday
before requesting TGP to move the remaining balance.
TENNESSEE
GAS PIPELINE WILL CONFISCATE ANY REMAINING BALANCE NOT TRANSFERRED OR REQUESTED
BY THE CUSTOMER TO BE TRANSFERRED ON TERMINATED FIRM STORAGE CONTRACTS.
Please contact your Primary Gas Scheduler if you need
procedures and/or help with your storage transfer.

moving into the Northeast areas of its system, in order to protect the
operational integrity of its system, effective for the Gas Day (“GD”)

subject: EMERGENT REPAIR AT STA 264 RESOLVED
notice_text:
EMERGENT
REPAIR BETWEEN STA 264 EFFECTIVE 7-31-2026 RESOLVED
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee posted notice of an emergent repair at Station 264 Unit 1C
near Charlton City, Massachusetts on July 31, 2026 (Notice Identifier #403173).
Tennessee discovered an issue with one of the units that required immediate
repairs. The issue has now been resolved and the unit is returning to normal
operations. As such, nomination increases pathed through STA 261 Discharge
East (Segment 261 FH) will be accepted effective Timely Cycle for the Gas Day
of Tuesday, August 11, 2026 up to segment capacity as posted on TGP's EBB.
This
will be the final notice for this emergent repair.
Please
contact your Scheduler if you have any questions.

subject: EMERGENT REPAIR AT STA 264 EFF 7-31-26
notice_text:
EMERGENT
REPAIR BETWEEN STA 264 EFFECTIVE 7-31-2026
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee is posting notice of an emergent repair at Station 264 Unit
1C near Charlton City, Massachusetts. Tennessee has discovered an issue
with the unit that requires immediate repairs. Tennessee has personnel on site
and a repair plan is being developed. Tennessee is estimating the current
impact to be up to 150,000 Dths. Based upon current nominations in the area, Secondary
Out of the Path nominations pathed through STA 261 Discharge East (Segment 261
FH) are at risk effective Timely Cycle for the Gas Day of August 1, 2026 and
until further notice. Previously scheduled nominations will not be curtailed
for the remainder of the July 31, 2026 Gas Day. However, all increases pathed
through STA 261 Discharge East (Segment 261 FH) are at risk.
Updates
will be posted as more information becomes available.
Please
contact your Scheduler if you have any questions.

subject: EMERGENT REPAIR MLV 113-2-114-2 EFF 7-8
notice_text:
EMERGENT
REPAIR BETWEEN MLV 113-2 AND MLV 114-2 (BROAD RUN LATERAL) EFFECTIVE 7-8-2026
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee is posting notice of an emergent repair between MLV 113-2 and
MLV 114-2 near Catlettsburg, KY. The line has been isolated. Tennessee
has personnel on site to investigate repairs.
Tennessee
is estimating the current impact to be up to 150,000 Dths. Based upon
current nominations and due to ongoing scheduled maintenance in the area, no additional
impact to nominations is anticipated at this time.
Updates
will be posted as more information becomes available.
Please
contact your Scheduler if you have any questions.

subject: EMERGENT REPAIR 559-2A TO 560-2 EFF 7-7
notice_text:
EMERGENT
REPAIR BETWEEN MLV 559-2A TO 560-2 EFFECTIVE 7-7-2026
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee is posting notice of an emergent repair issue at MLV 559-2A
to 560-2 near Centerville, TN. Tennessee has discovered an issue that
necessitates repairs. Tennessee will need to isolate this area for pipeline
inspections. Tennessee is estimating the current impact to be up to 175,000
Dths. Based
upon current demand and nominations, Secondary Out of the Path nominations
pathed through STA 860 South 500 Line (Segment 548 BH) may be at risk as early
as Timely Cycle for the gas day of Wednesday, July 8, 2026 and until further
notice. Previously
scheduled volumes will not be curtailed for the current gas day of June 7,
2026; however, increases pathed through STA 860 South 500 Line (Segment 548 BH) for the remainder
of the gas day are at risk.
Updates
will be posted as more information becomes available.
Please
contact your Scheduler if you have any questions.

EMERGENT
REPAIR AT STA 32 RESOLVED
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee posted notice of an emergent repair issue at Station 32 near Jasper,

issue at the station which necessitated repairs. The issue has now
been resolved and the unit is in the process of returning to normal
operations. As such, nomination increases pathed through STA 32 (Segment 132
FH) will be accepted effective Timely Cycle for the Gas Day of Wednesday, July
1, 2026 up to segment capacity as posted on TGP's EBB.
This
will be the final notice for this emergent repair.
Please
contact your Scheduler if you have any questions.

subject: EMERGENT REPAIR MLV 4-1 TO 8-1 EFF 6-2
notice_text:
EMERGENT
REPAIR BETWEEN MLV 4-1 AND MLV 8-1 EFFECTIVE 6-2-2026
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee is posting notice of an Emergent Repair between MLV 4-1 and
MLV 8-1 near Victoria, Texas located in Victoria County. Tennessee has
identified an issue that necessitates repairs. Tennessee is currently evaluating
the impacts of the issue. The affected segment has been isolated. Based on
current nominations, Secondary Out of the Path nominations pathed through STA 9
(Segment 109 BH) could be at risk as early as Timely Cycle for the gas day of
Tuesday, June 2, 2026 and until further notice. Previously scheduled
nominations for the current gas day of June 1, 2026 will not be curtailed;
however, increases pathed through STA 9 (Segment 109 BH) for the remainder of
today's gas day are at risk.
Updates
will be provided as more information becomes available.
Please
contact your Account Representative or Scheduler if you have any questions.

subject: EMERGENT REPAIR STA 563 1A EFF 8-28-26
notice_text:
EMERGENT
REPAIR AT STA 563 UNIT 1A EFFECTIVE 8-28-2026
Pursuant
to Article XII of the General Terms and Conditions of Tennessee's FERC Gas
Tariff, Tennessee is posting notice of an emergent repair issue at STA 563 near
Centerville, TN (Segment 860 BH). During the scheduled annual inspection and
safety device check Tennessee identified an issue at Unit 1A which requires
immediate repairs. Personnel are onsite and evaluating the repairs.
Tennessee is estimating the impact to be up to an additional 315,000 Dth pathed
through STA 860 North (Segment 860 BH). Based upon current nominations,
restrictions through a pro rata portion of Secondary Out of the Path
nominations pathed through STA 860 North (Segment 860 BH) are at risk as early
as Timely Cycle for the Gas Day of Sunday, August 30, 2026 and until further
notice. Previously scheduled volumes pathed through STA 860 North (Segment 860
BH) will not be curtailed; however, all increases pathed through STA 860 North
(Segment 860 BH) for the remainder of today's Gas Day, August 28, 2026, and Saturday's
Gas Day, August 29, 2026, are at risk.
Updates
will be posted as more information becomes available.
Please
contact your Scheduler if you have any questions.

subject: MONTHLY STORAGE TRANSFER REMINDER
notice_text:
MONTHLY STORAGE TRANSFERS FOR SEPTEMBER 1,
2026
DART provides the ability for storage customers to
enter their own storage transfers online. The transfers must be confirmed
on or before the effective date. If you have a terminated or recalled
contract that needs the balance transferred to the base storage contract holder
or a new contract, these transfers need to be completed on or before the
first of the month.
For terminated storage contracts per the firm storage
rate schedule of the Tennessee Gas Pipeline tariff on First Revised Sheet No.
217, Section 11: “Shippers must withdraw or transfer its Storage Balance on
or before the date of the expiration of its FS Service Agreement. To the
extent that a Shipper fails to dispose of or transfer its entire Storage
Balance, Transporter shall retain and take title to Shipper's remaining Storage
Balance at no cost to Transporter.”
PLEASE NOTE:
When the first of the month falls on a weekend or holiday, any
small volume left on a terminated or recalled storage contract will be moved
for the customers by TGP to the new valid contract if requested by the customer
on the first business day following the weekend or holiday
provided that efforts have been made prior to the first and/or
holiday to transfer allocated balances prior to the weekend and/or holiday
before requesting TGP to move the remaining balance.
TENNESSEE
GAS PIPELINE WILL CONFISCATE ANY REMAINING BALANCE NOT TRANSFERRED OR REQUESTED
BY THE CUSTOMER TO BE TRANSFERRED ON TERMINATED FIRM STORAGE CONTRACTS.
Please contact your Primary Gas Scheduler if you need
procedures and/or help with your storage transfer.
